title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Bucket
description: A bucket (called UsageVolumProduct in the SID Model) represents and tracks a quantity of usage (remaining or consumed). It could be either a quantity or an amount in a currency. It can represent a fixed number of SMS,MMS, call minutes, quantity of data and so on (TM Forum TMF654 Prepay Balance Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition Bucket; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Bucket:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Bucket'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Bucket:<tmfId>. Unique Identifier within the server for the bucket

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/href'. A resource URI pointing to the resource in the OB that stores the detailed information for the bucket

confirmationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/confirmationDate'. Date when the deduction was confirmed in the server

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/description'. Text describing the contents of the balance managed by the bucket

isShared.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/isShared'. True if the bucket is shared between several devices or users

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/name'. Friendly name to identify the bucket

remainingValueName.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/remainingValueName'. Remaining amount in a formatted string for the bucket given in the balance unit (for example 1.9 Gb). This formatted string could be used for display needs for example

requestedDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/requestedDate'. Date when the deduction request was received in the server

logicalResource.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/logicalResource'. reference to the LogicalResource eg MSISDN

partyAccount.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/partyAccount'. A reference to the account that owns the bucket. In TMF this is a PartyAccountRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced PartyAccount entity (urn:ngsi-ld:PartyAccount:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

product.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/product'. In TMF this is an array of ProductRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Product entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Product:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/relatedParty'. Used to provide information about any other entity with relation to the balance, for instance to define customer hierarchy for the balance (e.g.: customerId, userId, )

remainingValue.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/remainingValue'. Indicate the amount on the bucket

reservedValue.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Bucket/properties/reservedValue'. Indicate the amount reserved on the bucket
